0022600040.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-4, 2nd in the Pacific and 6th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with the Warriors on a 1-game losing streak after an 8-2 stretch and the Spurs riding a 10-game winning streak. Golden State is without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Stephen Curry (abdomen), and Gary Payton II is day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), with Devin Vassell day-to-day with a groin injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on April 1, 2026 in San Francisco, a 127-113 Warriors loss.
